unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 1 - Find Your Fight - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. Three pictures held all term: flag (claim), magnifier (prove), megaphone (sell). Weeks 1-5 final piece: a published persuasive text on an issue from The Last Bear.

lessons.title: Big Questions from Bear Island
lessons.focus: Turn a theme from The Last Bear into an arguable should-question and take a side. Critical feature: an issue is a question fair people disagree on, not a fact. Retrieves: Term 3 persuasive writing (opinion plus reasons).

lessons.title: Say It Like You Mean It
lessons.focus: Write a strong position statement with high-modality words and a fronted because-clause. Critical feature: the modal word sets how sure the writer sounds. Retrieves: Term 3 main and subordinate clauses.

lessons.title: Walk in Their Boots
lessons.focus: Cut-and-paste perspective sort, then write a paragraph from another person's point of view. Critical feature: who is speaking changes what they care about. Fun activity: cut and paste.

lessons.title: Debate Day
lessons.focus: Run a mini debate and write a rebuttal paragraph: Some people say... However... Critical feature: name the other side fairly, then beat it with a reason.
